headline: DJI Neo drone hits $139, affordable drone photography
summary: DJI's Neo drone offers 4K sensor, voice controls, and propeller guards for $139.
details: The DJI Neo drone is now available for $139, making drone photography more accessible. It features a 4K sensor on a gimbal with voice controls for easy capture sessions.
The drone also comes with propeller guards for safety and a physical remote for more precise control. Its lightweight design (135g) makes it easy to carry around.

The Neo is DJI's first-generation miniature drone designed for autonomous flights with object tracking and preconfigured flight paths. It has five standard flight modes and a customizable mode through the DJI Fly app.
caption:
Can you capture stunning aerial footage for just $139? DJI's Neo drone makes it possible.

The DJI Neo drone is now available for $139, making drone photography more accessible. It features a 4K sensor on a gimbal with voice controls for easy capture sessions.

The drone also comes with propeller guards for safety and a physical remote for more precise control. Its lightweight design (135g) makes it easy to carry around.

The Neo is DJI's first-generation miniature drone designed for autonomous flights with object tracking and preconfigured flight paths. It has five standard flight modes and a customizable mode through the DJI Fly app.
